description:
One resource deposit's record by numeric id (relays GET /api/v1/deposits/{id}), including its
    `commodities[]` ({name, role: primary|byproduct, group} — the commodity graph, with `resource_type`
    as the primary label) and operators. Pair with `deposits(commodity=...)`: search by commodity,
    then read the deposit. Quote with `billing_quote("/api/v1/deposits/{id}")`.Metered: charged to your own wallet — see the server instructions (CHARGING); quote first with `billing_quote`.

id.description: The deposit's numeric id (from `deposits`, a pin, or a relationship row).
id.title: Id
